https://w3id.org/eudpp#BackgroundDatabas.notes: Proposal: oec:BackgroundDatabase (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:BackgroundDatabase. Source representing a background LCI database used for the LCA modelling (e.g. ecoinvent, GaBi/Sphera, Okobaudat).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#ComplianceSystem.notes: Proposal: oec:ComplianceSystem (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:ComplianceSystem. A standard or programme against which an LCA or EPD study is declared compliant, such as ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, PEFCR programmes, or a specific programme operator's scheme.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#CriterionA.notes: Proposal: oec:SoCCriterionA (individual of oec:SoCCriterion) skos:exactMatch eudpp:CriterionA. ESPR 2024/1781 Article 2(27). CHECK: oec:SoCCriterion is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#CriterionB.notes: Proposal: oec:SoCCriterionB (individual of oec:SoCCriterion) skos:exactMatch eudpp:CriterionB. ESPR 2024/1781 Article 2(27). CHECK: oec:SoCCriterion is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#CriterionC.notes: Proposal: oec:SoCCriterionC (individual of oec:SoCCriterion) skos:exactMatch eudpp:CriterionC. ESPR 2024/1781 Article 2(27). CHECK: oec:SoCCriterion is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#CriterionD.notes: Proposal: oec:SoCCriterionD (individual of oec:SoCCriterion) skos:exactMatch eudpp:CriterionD. ESPR 2024/1781 Article 2(27). CHECK: oec:SoCCriterion is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#EC.notes: Substance identifier schemes stay flat properties (oec:ecNumber); no scheme individual.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#ECHA.notes: Substance identifier schemes stay flat properties (echaNumber proposed); no scheme individual.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#EN15804InventoryI.notes: Proposal: oec:EN15804InventoryIndicator (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:EN15804InventoryIndicator. An EN 15804+A2 inventory‑level indicator (resource use, waste disposed, or output flow for valorisation/exported energy). The value is an aggregated inventory quantity; results are represented by eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult instances.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#ImpactModel.notes: Proposal: oec:ImpactModel (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:ImpactModel. The characterisation model underlying an LCIA method (e.g. IPCC AR6 2021 for GWP). It carries a model name, optional version and optional bibliographic source.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#LCAIndicator.notes: Proposal: oec:LCAIndicator (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:LCAIndicator. Abstract umbrella class for an indicator definition (impact or inventory category) that a method calculates values for. Each instance identifies exactly one method under which it is computed.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#LCAMethod.notes: Proposal: oec:LCAMethod (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:LCAMethod. A life‑cycle assessment method that produces values for one indicator from an inventory of elementary flows, covering both characterised LCIA methods and inventory aggregation methods such as EN 15804+A2 inventory indicators.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#LCAMethodReport.notes: Proposal: oec:LCIAMethodReport (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:LCAMethodReport. Source that documents a life‑cycle impact assessment (LCIA) method, such as the EF 3.1 method description.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#LCAMethodology.notes: Proposal: oec:LCAMethodology (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:LCAMethodology. A named, versioned LCA methodology—a coherent set of LCA methods sharing principles and a common set of characterisation factors. Individual Method instances belong to one or more LCAMethodology instances.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#LCAStudy.notes: Proposal: oec:LCAStudy (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:LCAStudy. A life‑cycle assessment study of a product, conducted per ISO 14040/14044, producing one or more LCA results. It contains study‑level metadata such as UUID, dataset version, name, reference year, license, copyright, ILCD format version, compliance declarations, manufacturer records, reviews and references to data sources or background databases.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#LicenseType.notes: Proposal: oec:LicenseType (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:LicenseType. Closed enumeration of licence categories that govern access to and use of an LCA or EPD study.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#SoCCriterionSchem.notes: Proposal: oec:SoCCriterionScheme (skos:ConceptScheme) skos:exactMatch eudpp:SoCCriterionScheme. The scheme that holds the four ESPR Art. 2(27) criteria; see the SoC criteria rows.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#TypeOfReview.notes: Proposal: oec:TypeOfReview (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:TypeOfReview. Enumeration of the kind of critical review or verification performed on a dataset, matching ILCD TypeOfReviewValues.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#accessRestriction.notes: Proposal: oec:accessRestrictions (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:accessRestrictions. Human‑readable description of the access and use restrictions for an LCA or EPD study, equivalent to dcterms:accessRights.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#accreditedThirdPa.notes: Proposal: oec:AccreditedThirdPartyReview (individual of oec:TypeOfReview) skos:exactMatch eudpp:accreditedThirdPartyReview. ILCD+EPD review type.

CHECK: oec:LCIAImpactIndicator, oec:LCIAImpactCategory is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#belongsToEn15804G.notes: Proposal: oec:belongsToEn15804Group (property, range oec:EN15804IndicatorGroup) skos:exactMatch eudpp:belongsToEn15804Group. https://w3id.org/eudpp#belongsToMethodol.notes: Proposal: oec:belongsToMethodology (property, range oec:LCAMethodology) skos:exactMatch eudpp:belongsToMethodology. Links an LCAMethod to one or more LCAMethodology individuals it belongs to (e.g. eudpp:methodology_EF3_1). https://w3id.org/eudpp#climateChange.notes: Proposal: oec:ClimateChange (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:climateChange. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#computedByMethod.notes: Proposal: oec:computedByMethod (property, range oec:LCAMethod) skos:exactMatch eudpp:computedByMethod. https://w3id.org/eudpp#dataSetVersion.notes: Proposal: oec:dataSetVersion (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:dataSetVersion. Version number of this LCA/EPD study instance, independent of the ontology version. Format: major.minor.sub‑minor (e.g., "02.00.011").

True if the module value is declared in the study (has a numerical amount), false if explicitly marked as not declared (ND/MND). Absence of the triple means the module was not in scope.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#landUseSoilQualit.notes: Proposal: oec:LandUseSoilQuality (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:landUseSoilQuality. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#lcaVerifier.notes: Proposal: oec:LcaVerifier (individual of oec:ActorRole) skos:exactMatch eudpp:lcaVerifier. LCA verifier role (ILCD review); CHECK: oec:ActorRole is a closed owl:oneOf list per EN 18239, extend the list. CHECK: extend the closed oec:ActorRole list.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#licenseFee.notes: Proposal: oec:LicenseFee (individual of oec:LicenseType) skos:exactMatch eudpp:licenseFee. ILCD+EPD licence type.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#licenseOther.notes: Proposal: oec:LicenseOther (individual of oec:LicenseType) skos:exactMatch eudpp:licenseOther. ILCD+EPD licence type.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#marineEcotoxicity.notes: Proposal: oec:MarineEcotoxicity (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:marineEcotoxicity. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#massFractionUnit.notes: Units are gs1:unitCode values (UN/ECE Rec. 20); a mass-fraction unit is a code there, not a term of ours.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodVersion.notes: Proposal: oec:methodVersion (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodVersion. Version identifier of a specific LCIA or inventory method instance, distinct from the overarching methodology version.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodologyVersio.notes: Proposal: oec:methodologyVersion (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodologyVersion. Version identifier of an LCAMethodology instance (e.g. "3.1" for EF 3.1, "2002" for CML 2002).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodology_CML20.notes: Proposal: oec:MethodologyCML2002 (individual of oec:LCAMethodology) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodology_CML2002. LCA methodology (EF 3.0/3.1, CML 2002, ReCiPe 2016, IPCC AR6, EN 15804 inventory rules).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodology_EF3_0.notes: Proposal: oec:MethodologyEF30 (individual of oec:LCAMethodology) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodology_EF3_0. LCA methodology (EF 3.0/3.1, CML 2002, ReCiPe 2016, IPCC AR6, EN 15804 inventory rules).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodology_EF3_1.notes: Proposal: oec:MethodologyEF31 (individual of oec:LCAMethodology) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodology_EF3_1. LCA methodology (EF 3.0/3.1, CML 2002, ReCiPe 2016, IPCC AR6, EN 15804 inventory rules).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodology_EN158.notes: Proposal: oec:MethodologyEN15804InventoryRules (individual of oec:LCAMethodology) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodology_EN15804InventoryRules. LCA methodology (EF 3.0/3.1, CML 2002, ReCiPe 2016, IPCC AR6, EN 15804 inventory rules).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodology_IPCC_.notes: Proposal: oec:MethodologyIPCCAR6 (individual of oec:LCAMethodology) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodology_IPCC_AR6. LCA methodology (EF 3.0/3.1, CML 2002, ReCiPe 2016, IPCC AR6, EN 15804 inventory rules).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#methodology_ReCiP.notes: Proposal: oec:MethodologyReCiPe2016 (individual of oec:LCAMethodology) skos:exactMatch eudpp:methodology_ReCiPe2016. LCA methodology (EF 3.0/3.1, CML 2002, ReCiPe 2016, IPCC AR6, EN 15804 inventory rules).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#modelVersion.notes: Proposal: oec:modelVersion (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:modelVersion. Version of the characterisation model used (e.g. "IPCC AR6 2021" vs "IPCC AR5 2013").

https://w3id.org/eudpp#notCompliant.notes: Proposal: oec:NotCompliant (individual of oec:LcaComplianceStatus) skos:exactMatch eudpp:notCompliant. ILCD+EPD compliance status. CHECK: oec:LcaComplianceStatus is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#notReviewed.notes: Proposal: oec:NotReviewed (individual of oec:TypeOfReview) skos:exactMatch eudpp:notReviewed. ILCD+EPD review type.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#partiallyComplian.notes: Proposal: oec:PartiallyCompliant (individual of oec:LcaComplianceStatus) skos:exactMatch eudpp:partiallyCompliant. ILCD+EPD compliance status. CHECK: oec:LcaComplianceStatus is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#photochemicalOzon.notes: Proposal: oec:PhotochemicalOzoneFormation (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:photochemicalOzoneFormation. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#providesLCAData.notes: Proposal: oec:providesLCAData (property, range xsd:boolean) skos:exactMatch eudpp:providesLCAData. Indicates whether the manufacturer in this record supplied primary LCA data for the study.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#referenceToComple.notes: Proposal: oec:referenceToCompleteReviewReport (property, range oec:DocumentReference) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceToCompleteReviewReport. Link from a Review to the full review report.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#referenceToCompli.notes: Proposal: oec:referenceToComplianceStatus (property, range eubat:ComplianceStatus) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceToComplianceStatus. Level of compliance declared by a ComplianceDeclaration (fully compliant, partially compliant, or not compliant).

Proposal: oec:referenceToComplianceSystem (property, range oec:ComplianceSystem) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceToComplianceSystem. Link from a ComplianceDeclaration to the standard or programme it references (e.g., EN 15804+A2, ISO 14025, ISO 21930).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#referenceToExtern.notes: Proposal: oec:referenceToExternalSource (property, range oec:DocumentReference) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceToExternalSource. Link from an LCAMethod to the external documentation that describes the method.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#referenceToLCAMet.notes: Proposal: oec:referenceToLCAMethodReport (property, range oec:LCIAMethodReport) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceToLCAMethodReport. Link from an LCAMethod to the formal LCIA method report that describes it (e.g., EF 3.1).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#referenceToModelS.notes: Proposal: oec:referenceToModelSource (property, range oec:DocumentReference) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceToModelSource. Link from an ImpactModel to the bibliographic source(s) that describe its characterisation model.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#referenceToOrigin.notes: Proposal: oec:referenceToOriginalEPD (property, range oec:DocumentReference) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceToOriginalEPD. Link from an EPDStudy to the published EPD document (typically a PDF).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#referenceYear.notes: Proposal: oec:referenceYear (property, range xsd:gYear) skos:exactMatch eudpp:referenceYear. Start year of the time period for which the LCA study is valid.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#relatesToLCAIndic.notes: Proposal: oec:relatesToLCAIndicator (property, range oec:LCIAImpactIndicator) skos:exactMatch eudpp:relatesToLCAIndicator. Links an EN15804 impact indicator to the conceptually corresponding EF 3.1 / PEF LCIA impact indicator, recording a conceptual correspondence without implying equivalence. CHECK: oec:LCIAImpactIndicator is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#resourceUseFossil.notes: Proposal: oec:ResourceUseFossil (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:resourceUseFossil. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#resourceUseMinera.notes: Proposal: oec:ResourceUseMineralsMetals (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:resourceUseMineralsMetals. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#respiratoryInorga.notes: Proposal: oec:RespiratoryInorganics (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:respiratoryInorganics. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#reviewDate.notes: Proposal: oec:reviewDate (property, range xsd:date) skos:exactMatch eudpp:reviewDate. Date on which the review was completed, allowing DPP consumers to assess currency of the review.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#sourceVocabulary.notes: Proposal: oec:sourceVocabulary (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:sourceVocabulary. Provenance annotation identifying the vocabulary, standard or ontology from which a class, property or individual of this ontology aligns.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#terrestrialEcotox.notes: Proposal: oec:TerrestrialEcotoxicity (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:terrestrialEcotoxicity. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#uuid.notes: Proposal: oec:uuid (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:uuid. Universally Unique Identifier of an LCA/EPD study, generated once and unchanged; increments eudpp:dataSetVersion on updates.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#waterUseDeprivati.notes: Proposal: oec:WaterUseDeprivation (individual of oec:ImpactCategory) skos:exactMatch eudpp:waterUseDeprivation. ILCD / Environmental Footprint 3.1 impact category. CHECK: oec:ImpactCategory is a class stub this proposal adds.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#performedAt.notes: EPCIS readPoint / bizLocation of the event.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#performedBy.notes: EPCIS sourceList / destinationList (owning_party, possessing_party) of the event.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasActorRoleAssig.notes: EPCIS sourceList / destinationList carry the actor and its role on the event.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#isActorRoleAssign.notes: Inverse of the above; the EPCIS event is the context.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasProductStatus.notes: EPCIS disposition / persistentDisposition of the item (CBV values, plus our oec:Disp-* extension values).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#FacilityIdentifie.notes: Facilities are identified by GS1 GLN (AI 414); no scheme term needed.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#SubstanceIdentifi.notes: Substance identifiers are flat properties here (oec:casNumber, oec:ecNumber, echaNumber to adopt), not a scheme/value pair.
See SubstanceIdentifierScheme: flat identifier properties instead of a reified identifier.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#identifierJurisdi.notes: GS1 keys are global; a jurisdiction qualifier only matters for national schemes.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#echaNumber.notes: Proposal: oec:echaNumber (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:echaNumber. Number assigned to the substance by the European Chemicals Agency, when available and appropriate. CHECK: oec:Substance is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#minimumNumericalV.notes: Proposal: oec:minimumNumericalValue (property, range xsd:decimal) skos:exactMatch eudpp:minimumNumericalValue. The lower bound of a concentration range.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#maximumNumericalV.notes: Proposal: oec:maximumNumericalValue (property, range xsd:decimal) skos:exactMatch eudpp:maximumNumericalValue. The upper bound of a concentration range expressed as a decimal.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasRecyclingInstr.notes: rdfs:seeAlso from oec:endOfLifeInstructions (recycling guidance for the substance context).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasReuseInstructi.notes: rdfs:seeAlso from oec:endOfLifeInstructions; reuse guidance sits with end-of-life handling in our model.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#SubstancePresence.notes: Proposal: oec:SubstancePresence (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:SubstancePresence. Contextual relation entity representing the presence of a substance in a product, component or spare part as placed on the market. It allows location‑specific concentration and instruction data to be attached without treating those attributes as intrinsic properties of the substance itself.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#SoCQualificationA.notes: Proposal: oec:SoCQualificationAssertion (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:SoCQualificationAssertion. A documented, explicit assertion that a substance satisfies one or more non‑exclusive qualification criteria in ESPR Article 2(27). For criterion (d) the applicable product context is represented by a dpp:SubstancePresence linked through dpp:hasApplicableQualification.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasQualificationA.notes: Proposal: oec:hasQualificationAssertion (property, range oec:SoCQualificationAssertion) skos:exactMatch eudpp:hasQualificationAssertion. Links a SubstanceOfConcern to the SoCQualificationAssertion that documents its compliance status or assessment.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#qualifiesSubstanc.notes: Proposal: oec:qualifiesSubstance (property, range eutex:SubstanceOfConcern) skos:exactMatch eudpp:qualifiesSubstance. Links a SoC qualification assertion to the substance of concern that it positively qualifies.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasSoCCriterion.notes: Proposal: oec:hasSoCCriterion (property, range skos:Concept) skos:exactMatch eudpp:hasSoCCriterion. Links a Substance of Concern Qualification Assertion to one or more criteria that define the level of concern (e.g., A, B, C, D). CHECK: skos:Concept is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasApplicableQual.notes: Proposal: oec:hasApplicableQualification (property, range oec:SoCQualificationAssertion) skos:exactMatch eudpp:hasApplicableQualification. Links a SubstancePresence to an applicable SoC qualification assertion; the criterion applies in a presence‑scoped context.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#concernsSubstance.notes: Proposal: oec:concernsSubstance (property, range eutex:SubstanceOfConcern) skos:exactMatch eudpp:concernsSubstance. Links a reported SubstancePresence to the specific SubstanceOfConcern that is present, restricting the relation to substances identified as concerns rather than generic substances.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#isSubstancePresen.notes: Proposal: oec:isSubstancePresenceOf (property, range oec:DigitalProductPassport) skos:exactMatch eudpp:isSubstancePresenceOf. Inverse relation from a SubstancePresence instance to the Product that contains it.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#qualificationNote.notes: Proposal: oec:qualificationNote (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:qualificationNote. Additional explanation or limitation of a SoC qualification assertion.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#qualificationVali.notes: Proposal: oec:qualificationValidFrom (property, range xsd:date) skos:exactMatch eudpp:qualificationValidFrom. First date on which the qualification assertion is considered valid.
Proposal: oec:qualificationValidUntil (property, range xsd:date) skos:exactMatch eudpp:qualificationValidUntil. Last date on which the qualification assertion is considered valid, when bounded.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#SubstanceManageme.notes: Proposal: oec:SubstanceManagementInstruction (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:SubstanceManagementInstruction. Instruction concerning the management of a substance of concern within its SubstancePresence context, covering safe use, disassembly, preparation for reuse, recycling and environmentally sound end‑of‑life handling.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasSubstancePrese.notes: Proposal: oec:hasSubstancePresence (property, range oec:SubstancePresence) skos:exactMatch eudpp:hasSubstancePresence. Links a product to the SubstancePresence instances that describe where and how a substance is present within the product.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#casName.notes: Proposal: oec:casName (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:casName. The Chemical Abstracts Service name of the substance, when available. CHECK: oec:Substance is not an existing or proposed class.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#internationalName.notes: Proposal: oec:internationalName (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:internationalName. An internationally recognised name for the substance used when an IUPAC name is not available.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasPreparationFor.notes: Proposal: oec:hasPreparationForReuseInstruction (property, range oec:SubstanceManagementInstruction) skos:exactMatch eudpp:hasPreparationForReuseInstruction. Links a SubstancePresence to the SubstanceManagementInstruction that contains guidance on how to prepare the substance for reuse.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#hasNextDPP.notes: Proposal: oec:hasNextDPP (property, range oec:DigitalProductPassport) skos:exactMatch eudpp:hasNextDPP. Links a Digital Product Passport to its successor passport, indicating the next version in the product’s lifecycle.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#manufacturingDate.notes: gs1:productionDate (AI 11) on the product / lot master data.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#countryOfOrigin.notes: gs1:countryOfOrigin on the product master data.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#productTradeMark.notes: gs1:brand / gs1:brandName on the product master data.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#EnvironmentalFoot.notes: rdfs:seeAlso from eutex:EnvironmentalFootprint; whether a core class is warranted is for the next textile round.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#EnergyConsumption.notes: Proposal: oec:EnergyConsumptionResult (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:EnergyConsumptionResult. An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the consumption of primary energy resources—renewable and non‑renewable—in a product system. It is typically associated with EN 15804+A2 primary energy indicators (e.g. PERE, PERM, PERT, PENRE, PENRM, PENRT) but may span multiple indicators depending on study scope.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#SustainableRenewa.notes: Proposal: oec:SustainableRenewableMaterialsUseResult (class) skos:exactMatch eudpp:SustainableRenewableMaterialsUseResult. LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the use of renewable secondary material and fuel inputs in a product system, typically aligned with EN 15804+A2 indicators such as Use of Renewable Secondary Fuels (RSF).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#forScenario.notes: Proposal: oec:forScenario (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:forScenario. Identifier of the scenario this LCIA module value applies to (free‑text label matching the EPD’s scenario declaration).

https://w3id.org/eudpp#quantifiesIndicat.notes: Proposal: oec:quantifiesIndicator (property, range oec:LCAIndicator) skos:exactMatch eudpp:quantifiesIndicator. Links an LCA result (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult) to the LCAIndicator that it quantifies.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#materialTypeSchem.notes: Proposal: oec:materialTypeScheme (property, range xsd:anyURI) skos:exactMatch eudpp:materialTypeScheme. Reference system (e.g. ISO 11224, EU Textile Regulation 1007/2011 Annex I) that defines the coding of a material type.

https://w3id.org/eudpp#materialTypeValue.notes: Proposal: oec:materialTypeValue (property, range xsd:string) skos:exactMatch eudpp:materialTypeValue. Code or label from the scheme identified by materialTypeScheme that specifies a particular material type.
